function.name: get_func_def
function.description: Retrieve the full function definition, including line numbers, from the specified source file. The func_name must be related to src_file: it must be defined, declared, called, or referenced in the specified file. Do not query unrelated functions.

func_name.description: Function name that must appear or be referenced in src_file.

src_file.description: Source file that contains or references func_name.
